name: 100K Solar
old_description: Get Started Today for a No-Cost, no obligation solar estimate and see how much you can save with Solar Energy.
about:
100K Solar is based in Barnegat, New Jersey. The company’s founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The firm provides residential and commercial solar panel installation services, operating its own installation crews rather than subcontracting. Its turn-key process covers system design, permitting, and installation on roof types including asphalt shingle and metal. The company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual project volume.

100K Solar serves homeowners and businesses primarily in New Jersey, with referenced projects in Logan Township and Egg Harbor Township, and also lists Houston, Texas as a service area. Its customer base includes residential property owners seeking no-upfront-cost solar agreements and commercial clients pursuing similar arrangements.

The company emphasizes a consultative, low-pressure sales approach and customizes each installation to the property. It promotes a “no-cost” model in which the installer covers equipment and labor costs, with reimbursement from New Jersey incentives.
built_on: Turn-key service from design through installation
Customized system design for each property
No-upfront-cost financing backed by New Jersey incentives
type_evidence: 100k Solar offers premium installations for solar panels. We operate our own installation teams and our consultants are professional, low pressure, and educational.
